notes.title: Foosball VR 0.6 has been released!
notes.content:
We are proud to release Foosball VR version 0.6

Features:

    11-Players Table
    Controller Buttons Settings
    Rise/Lower Axis Helper
    Recenter Axis Helper
    Enhanced On-bording Tutorial
    Axis Snap Helper
    More SFX
    Optimisation Pass
    UI Visual Improvements


Bugfixes:

    OnBoarding - tutorial is broken after watching it more than once
    UI control visual state retention when dismissing the UI entirely


Known bugs:
Please refer to our public issue tracker[bitbucket.org]

notes.title: Foosball VR 0.5.1 has been released!
notes.content:
We are proud to release Foosball VR version 0.5.1

Bugfixes:

 The Settings are now persisted between game launches,
 The current tutorial state is properly displayed in the UI,
 Change in AI difficulty resets the game if one is in progress,
 The tutorial voice level has been increased,
 Some added visual enhancements regarding hands interactions with the environment.


Known bugs:
Please refer to our  public issue tracker

notes.title: Welcome to Foosball VR Early Access!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to present an early access version of Foosball VR. It is the first title of Coduar. At the moment you can expect some rough edges here and there, but these will be smoothed out on a regular basis. We take quality very seriously so at the end of this journey you will get a high-quality VR game. New features will come too - just give us some time.

What can you expect in the coming weeks?

We would like to focus on squashing bugs first to establish a stable foundation new features will stand on. We might miss some of them, so please report anything you find. You can use the Bugs Reporting sub forum, but we might come up with a better solution in the future.

Expect some more info to come soon.

Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː
